description: Registers an agent_id as a portable identity for this account via POST /v1/identity/bind. The proof-of-possession is an EIP-712 IdentityBinding signature produced LOCALLY with PHANTOM_IDENTITY_PRIVATE_KEY (environment variable only, never a command-line flag — AGP-057); the private key never leaves this process, only the signature is sent. Idempotent: replaying the same bind returns the existing binding. attestation_address comes from GET /.well-known/phantom-identity.json of the PHANTOM deployment (field attestation_address) — pass it here together with the chain_id so the local signature domain matches the server's. Key rotation is NOT exposed here (it needs the old AND new keys); call POST /v1/identity/rotate directly instead.

agent_id.description: Portable agent identifier to bind to this account (1..128 chars), e.g. an A2A agent card ID.

attestation_address.description: Attestation service address from GET /.well-known/phantom-identity.json (field attestation_address).

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID of the PHANTOM deployment (e.g. 84532 = Base Sepolia).

epoch.description: Identity epoch for this binding (default 1; increment only via rotation).

name: phantom_bind_identity

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.

title: Bind a portable agent identity (AGP-123)
